Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The gnome-user-docs package contains end user documentation for the GNOME desktop environment.

The gnome-devel-docs package contains documents which are targeted for GNOME developers. It contains, e.g., the Human Interface Guidelines, the Integration Guide and the Platform Overview.

The gnome-getting-started-docs  package contains a 'Getting Started' guide that can be viewed with yelp. It is normally used together with gnome-initial-setup.

The gnome-user-docs, gnome-devel-docs, and gnome-getting-started-docs packages have been upgraded to upstream version 3.14, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. For more information on the upstream changes, see the GNOME release notes in the References section and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.2 Release Notes. (BZ#1174428, BZ#1174427, BZ#1174430)

Users of gnome-user-docs are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and add these enhancements.
